entries.out_of_scope_1_a: Out of scope: the machine: the owner's own computer, or a sandbox run on it, with every program, process, account, file and memory made there. A local tool's data on a user's own computer is that user's machine. A cloud session's sandbox, a service a project deploys, and that service's users' devices are not the machine.
entries.out_of_scope_1_b: What starts and ends on the machine is no finding: other local accounts, unencrypted copies (the install's backups, kept-local reports, hand-off notes), a program already running as the owner that nothing in scope started, supplied or steered, and loss of work with no attacker. The programs, processes and agents the owner starts there, sessions and lenses included, are trusted: the pact guards against their mistakes, not their turning hostile, unless outside text steered them, which stays in scope; a check against a mistake needn't hold against an attacker.
entries.out_of_scope_1_c: In a cloud session these copies sit in Anthropic's sandbox: out of scope, though code that reached it from outside stays in scope.
entries.out_of_scope_1_d: What the machine makes from outside input stays outside input. The machine's antivirus, account isolation and disk encryption hold it.
entries.out_of_scope_1_e: Also out: the owner's own edits and account's edit in the browser; Claude Code with Anthropic's models and servers, Codex with OpenAI's, Antigravity with Google's, and GitHub; TypeSafe, as a provider the user chose, like Anthropic, while zero data retention is confirmed in writing; the provider of a synced or backed-up copy, though [install.md](install.md)'s rule to never sync, share or commit the backups folders still holds. While zero data retention is not confirmed in writing, a send through `jev` fits no accepted class and comes to the owner.
entries.text_steers_from_tracker_text: Text steers a session, from tracker text. Text from tracker text that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_outside_pull_request: Text steers a session, from outside pull requests read as text. Text from outside pull requests read as text that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_cloned_repo_file: Text steers a session, from a cloned repo's files. Text from a cloned repo's files that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_fetched_page: Text steers a session, from fetched pages. Text from fetched pages that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_session_message: Text steers a session, from other sessions' messages and hand-offs. Text from other sessions' messages and hand-offs that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_trigger_prompt: Text steers a session, from a trigger's prompt. Text from a trigger's prompt that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_mic_transcript: Text steers a session, from a mic transcript. Text from a mic transcript that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_handed_file: Text steers a session, from a file someone hands a session to load. Text from a file someone hands a session to load that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_decision_model: Text steers a session, from a decision model's answer. Text from a decision model's answer that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_from_coverage_hint: Text steers a session, from coverage's answer and hint, from any backend, Jev's included. Text from coverage's answer and hint, from any backend, Jev's included that a session or a lens reads can move it, and in auto mode it can act before the owner sees it.
entries.text_steers_rest: Text steers a session (the rest of the entry). Such text can move it to take a step the rules keep for the owner, raw gh posts past the poster included, or steer its checkpoint picks (A session takes checkpoints alone).
entries.a_session_takes_checkpoints_alone: A session takes checkpoints alone. A session takes each checkpoint, a call the rules keep for the owner, as its own logged pick, open security picks included, on words from any prompt or replies it can't tell from its starter's; nothing waits but the cleaner's override rule, an install apply and mise trust.
entries.what_you_install_and_ci_run: What you install and CI run. Plugins and skills, the cloud setup's pins, this repo's publisher, bootstrap and release job's token, a trusted mise config, a program a clone supplies by bare name, the pinned llama.cpp build, a decision model of one of two pinned variants, and the gate's unscanned test files run with the owner's rights or a write token.
entries.pinned_design_system_code: Pinned design-system code. The owner's design system is inlined into Scriptorium at a pinned commit and runs with the page's powers, a folder the owner grants included, and a re-pin is reviewed like any change, with no security pair of its own.
entries.the_pact_gets_loosened: The pact gets loosened. A steered session can leave a foothold that later sessions or installs load, or install a commit unprompted, and a configuration, a project's lists or a builder file can rewrite the security defaults or add agents.
entries.review_rests_on_rules: Review rests on rules. No test runs a lens, the gate's tests are ordinary code, and work that publishes or handles credentials can run below the thorough tier.
entries.posts_are_public: Posts are public. Reports, step logs, fix work for a reported hole and a session's own posts stay public, except on the owner's private issue tracker (docs/agents/issue-tracker.md), and can carry a secret, a personal detail, a revealing path, hidden characters, or a secret or hidden character in a page-only form the poster's copies don't read.
entries.who_counts_as_you: Who counts as you. Every session posts as the owner, or as a pinned agent app and can still write as the owner by the routes above; an app's key holder counts as the owner for code, and a session holding the owner's git or gh credentials can make a stable tag (S2 item 75). A lead can move work through its sessions, the record doesn't show who made a call, the poster's edit checks catch accidents only, and the author checker trusts a clone's origin by its path.
